svg.title: Lab K08: Health probes
svg.desc: Startup protects a slow boot, liveness restarts a stuck app and readiness decides who gets traffic.

svg.text: Liveness restarts the container. Readiness only removes it from the Service. They are different cures.

svg.text: READY tells you about readiness. RESTARTS tells you about liveness. Read both columns.
